output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow, allowing minted tokens to be retrieved arbitrarily by the contract owner.
The transferFrom function allows a user to transfer tokens to arbitrary addresses, allowing a potential attacker to steal all tokens from a user's account.
The sell function allows a potential attacker to set the sellPrice to 0, making it impossible to sell tokens.
The burn function allows a contract owner to burn arbitrary tokens, aka the 'tradeTrap' issue.
The transfer function allows a user to transfer tokens to arbitrary addresses, allowing a potential attacker to steal all tokens from a user's account.
